sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Smt Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Criminal Petition No.4500 of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.286 of 2020 dated 24.09.2020 of Indrapalem Police Station, East Godavari, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270 and 273 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "I.P.C.") and Section 5(1) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 (for short 'COTP Act').
2.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners before this Court are accused Nos.1 to 8 in the above said crime.
3. The brief facts of the case are that above crime was registered against the petitioners on the ground of transporting and storing of tobacco and gutkha products which are banned by the Government.

4. Heard Sri S.M.Subhan, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for the State.
5.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Sections 270 and 273 I.P.C relate to food safety standards.
Section 270 I.P.C speaks about malignant act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life and Section 273 of I.P.C speaks about sale of Noxious Food or Drink.

None of the sections under which the present crime is registered, is applicable to the present case as tobacco and gutkha will not spread any infection and it does not fall under category of food or drink or poison.
Therefore, the police have no power to register the offences under above sections except by the designated officers like Food Safety Officer.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Court in similar circumstances passed common order dated 18.12.2019 in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch, wherein it was held that tobacco does not fall within the definition of "food" as specified under Section 3(i)(j) of the FSS Act and so, registration of FIR is not permissible.
Therefore, he urged to allow this petition.
7. The above submissions are not disputed by learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

8. In the light of the aforementioned order, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in respect of F.I.R No.286 of 2020 dated 24.09.2020 of Indrapalem Police Station, East Godavari District are hereby quashed.
